neighbours.label: a superlative adjective naming a record (largest, longest, most popular, best-selling)
fire: Lake Superior is the largest freshwater lake in North America by area.
The Nile is often described as the world's longest river.
Football remains the most popular sport in much of South America.
At the time it was the best-selling novel ever printed in France.
The blue whale is the heaviest animal that has ever lived.
Hydrogen is the most abundant element in the universe.
Tokyo is the country's biggest city and its political centre.
The cheetah is the fastest land animal on the planet.
quiet: Lake Superior is a large freshwater lake in North America with cold water.
The Nile is often described as a long and ancient river.
Football remains a popular sport in much of South America.
At the time it was a well-selling novel printed in France.
The blue whale is a heavy animal that lives in every ocean.
Hydrogen is a common element found throughout the universe.
Tokyo is a big city and the country's political centre.
The cheetah is a fast land animal found on the savanna.

notes: Card top peaks: largest x7, common, longest, abundant, most-produced, most popular, best-selling, all in 'the world's X' frames. Near misses use the plain adjective.
